Descartes and sign brackets ensure all positive roots; nonwinning second P root does not cause phase transition. Regimes are D,B,C,D at alpha≈0.1400136787, beta≈1.60855434465, gamma≈6.70156212; ties exactly adjacent edges. Independent rational p_cl for lazy walk yields strict D optimum. At ell=1, B=1471/2187 and D=5/9. Finite code calculations corroborate, but infinite conclusion is algebra/LP/root signs.
